data.name: Laiqa
data.gender_notes: Laiqa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is called, invited, gentle, soft, and beautiful. The name Laiqa carries the meaning “Call, invitation, gentle, soft” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Laiqa usually hope their child will grow to embody call, invitation, gentle, soft and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a gentle and beautiful soul, who brings light and grace to those around her
data.etymology: Laiqa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Call, invitation, gentle, soft.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Laiqa total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: لائیقہ
in_arabic.meaning: أحلى الفتاة، جميلة، نادرة، حلوة، لطيفة
in_arabic.long_meaning: أصل الاسم لائیقہ من الاسم العربي لائیق، والذي يعني أحلى الفتاة، جميلة، نادرة، حلوة، لطيفة. ومن مصادر الاسم الكلمتان اللاتيٰ و العُق۔ يُستخدم الاسم لائیقہ للإشارة إلى إحدى نساء الصحابة، حيث كان لها دور إيجابي في نشر الإسلام. في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية، يُعتبر الاسم مناسبًا لفتيات جميلات، لطيفات، وذات شخصية لطيفة. يُعتبر الاسم أيضًا مناسبًا لفتيات يتميزن بجمالهم، ندرتهم، وحلوتهم.

This name has been given to many notable figures in Islamic history, including Sufi scholars and poets. In modern times, it is not an uncommon name among Muslims, especially in Urdu and Arabic speaking communities. The cultural significance of Laiqa is rooted in the tradition of Islamic scholarship and Sufism, which values the divine summons to God and the importance of responding to that call with grace, kindness, and beauty.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Laiqa carries deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, particularly in the context of Sufism. Laiqa is understood as the one who is called and responds with lovely qualities. In the spiritual realm, this name represents the divine call to the believer, inviting one to a deep and meaningful connection with God. Laiqa is also seen as a manifestation of God's gentleness, softness, and beauty, inspiring those who bear this name to cultivate these qualities in themselves and extend them to others. Overall, the name Laiqa serves as a reminder of the divine call and the importance of responding with grace, kindness, and beauty.
